info.name: An API of Ice And Fire
An API of Ice And Fire Get API Root

items.docs: Returns the API entry point with absolute URLs to the three top-level collections (books, characters, houses). Useful for hypermedia discovery — clients can crawl the API from this endpoint alone.

info.name: An API of Ice And Fire List Books

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (1-indexed). Defaults to 1.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Items per page (default 10, max 50).

params.name: name
params.description: Filter books by exact book name.

params.name: fromReleaseDate
params.description: Only include books released on or after this date (ISO 8601).

params.name: toReleaseDate
params.description: Only include books released on or before this date (ISO 8601).

items.docs: List all books in the A Song of Ice and Fire series. Supports filtering by name and release-date range, plus RFC 5988 Link-header pagination.

info.name: An API of Ice And Fire Get Book by ID

params.name: id
params.description: Numeric resource identifier.

items.docs: Retrieve a single book by its numeric ID. Returns the full hypermedia book resource with absolute character and POV-character URLs.

info.name: An API of Ice And Fire List Characters

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (1-indexed). Defaults to 1.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Items per page (default 10, max 50).

params.name: name
params.description: Filter characters by name.

params.name: gender
params.description: Filter characters by gender (e.g. Male, Female).

params.name: culture
params.description: Filter characters by culture (e.g. Northmen, Dornish, Ironborn).

params.name: born
params.description: Filter characters by birth year (free-text, e.g. "In 283 AC").

params.name: died
params.description: Filter characters by death year (free-text).

params.name: isAlive
params.description: Filter to only living (true) or only dead (false) characters.

items.docs: List characters from the A Song of Ice and Fire universe. Supports filtering by name, gender, culture, birth year, death year, and living status, plus RFC 5988 Link-header pagination.

info.name: An API of Ice And Fire Get Character by ID

params.name: id
params.description: Numeric resource identifier.

items.docs: Retrieve a single character by its numeric ID. Returns the full hypermedia character resource with absolute allegiance, book, and POV-book URLs.

info.name: An API of Ice And Fire List Houses

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (1-indexed). Defaults to 1.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Items per page (default 10, max 50).

params.name: name
params.description: Filter houses by exact house name.

params.name: region
params.description: Filter houses by region (e.g. "The North", "The Reach").

params.name: words
params.description: Filter houses by house words (motto).

params.name: hasWords
params.description: Restrict to houses that have (true) or do not have (false) words.

params.name: hasTitles
params.description: Restrict to houses that have (true) or do not have (false) titles.

params.name: hasSeats
params.description: Restrict to houses that have (true) or do not have (false) seats.

params.name: hasDiedOut
params.description: Restrict to extinct (true) or surviving (false) houses.

params.name: hasAncestralWeapons
params.description: Restrict to houses that have (true) or do not have (false) ancestral weapons.

items.docs: List noble houses of Westeros and Essos. Supports filtering by name, region, words/motto, and various boolean has-* filters, plus RFC 5988 Link-header pagination.

info.name: An API of Ice And Fire Get House by ID

params.name: id
params.description: Numeric resource identifier.

items.docs: Retrieve a single house by its numeric ID. Returns the full hypermedia house resource with absolute current-lord, heir, overlord, founder, cadet-branch, and sworn-member URLs.
